treatments: Frying at 180 ± 5 °C for 180 s in RBO formulations after 9, 18, 27, 36 h of oil heating
methods_quote: The frying oil samples and fried fries at heating time 9, 18, 27 and 36 h were obtained for further determination.
replicates: All experiments were performed three times.
